activity_summary: You were home after the reading. The afternoon Shrew went on at the Theatre without you. You did not walk down. The Rose played Barnardo. You did not cross the river. You wrote nothing new.

quotes.text: The Shrew is at the Theatre this afternoon. I am not in it.
